ctx.x: impressed you, Tom. Do you know Joe Nanton-- Tricky Sam.

Yeah, he died while we was in -- up there in -- one of those shows, one of those roads coming from San Francisco. We had been out all night, see and I said to Tricky, I'm going on to bed, so he said all right and got up and I called him and he didn't answer, so it's time to go to the show and still he didn't answer and when they come in there and found --he had a hemmorhage, . He was dead.
I vaguelremember him and I knew him but he was always like a loner, wasn't he.
